job.style: a diary entry or letter by a student

response.passage: October 14th. Dear Diary, today was the final day of the Inter-School Chess Championship held at the Nehru Indoor Stadium. I was nervous because my hands were shaking from the cold air conditioning in the hall. My opponent, Rohan, played a very aggressive opening, but I managed to trap his knight by the 22nd move. The tournament director, Mr. Sharma, announced that 150 students participated this year, which is a record for our city. I felt relieved when I finally won the match. My coach, Mrs. Gupta, told me that my focus improved because I practiced meditation daily for the last month. I am exhausted now, but winning this trophy feels like a dream. I hope to play in the state-level tournament in December. It is funny how a small wooden board can make you feel like a warrior. I am going to sleep early tonight because I have a history test tomorrow morning.
response.summary: The narrator reflects on winning a chess match at a city tournament. They credit their success to consistent practice and feel proud of their achievement.
